_comment: MCP servers for the digital ecosystem. Merge the two entries under 'mcpServers' into your Claude Desktop config at %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (create the file if it doesn't exist), then FULLY restart Claude Desktop (quit from tray, reopen). Both run with --serve so the editors' 'Sync' buttons work: topdown on :8765, schematic (gate) on :8766.
